_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): chat UI — message bubbles, streaming assistant text, input + send, auto-scroll. Controlled component (messages live in the parent); pair with feature-sse or any chat API. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-chat
description: Chat UI: message bubbles, streaming assistant text, input + send, auto-scroll. Controlled — pair with feature-sse or any chat API.
notes: Usage: <Chat messages={msgs} onSend={async (t) => { const reply = await api('/api/chat', {method:'POST', body:{message:t}}); setMsgs([...msgs, {id:2, role:'assistant', content: reply.text}]); }} streamingText={partialReply} title='Support chat' />. Controlled: the parent owns the message array; pass streamingText while an SSE/stream reply is in progress (feature-sse). Auto-scrolls on new messages. Wrap in a fixed-height container.
